v2_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given sufficient resources and at least 1 remaining resource v2_human type, when allocating, then return true
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: given sufficient res., when allocating zero resources remain, then return false
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_3: given request res. exceeds capacity, when allocating, then return false
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_4: given request res. is undefined, when allocating, then return false
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_5: given any negative res. request, when allocating, then return false
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_6: given non-dictionary request, when allocating, then return false raise ValueError

v2_human_g2_constraints.c_1: Constraint: every resource type must maintain at least 1 unit v2_human all request processed
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_2: Assumption: resource capacities and request amount are non-negative
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_3: Con: all requests must be dictionary type
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_4: Assumption: each request dictionary must be resource type as key and then returned value
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_5: Con: total resources allocated cannot exceed original capacity - 1

v2_human_g2_goal: The objective of the system is too allocate resources on assigned come to it while not over allocating more than it has available
v2_human_g2_input: 1. Number - is a unlen at an integer and a float where the integer/float represents the amount of resources. 2. requests - is a Dictionary a string and Number, the string requests which resource and Number represents how much capacity it for each resource type. 3. request - is a list of resources, it represent the resource requested and how much of it.
v2_human_g2_output: the function returns true if inputs are valid and the allocation is feasible. it returns false if inputs are invalid or allocation is not feasible. returns Error(ValueError) if inputs are not a dictionary format
